wholePhysicalScope: Native Rathaus perimeter and mapped roof, tower and fountain components.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the Rathausmarkt wings, copper roofs, tower and courtyard basin. Near levels resolve sandstone bay frames, dormers, clock faces and lanterns.
limitations: Hamburg City Hall is represented in its 2009–2010 exterior, including the Rathausmarkt façade, clock tower, roofs and Hygieia courtyard fountain.
The official 111 m width and 112 m tower height and mapped roof parts constrain the main proportions. Individual statues, unseen windows and small roof ornaments are simplified.
The original Terrarium samples are preserved. Plaza paving, façade thresholds and courtyard grade are approximate.
